column1: # Native source catalogue for Justice > Intelligence > Interrogations.
# Extracted from installed Windows PE instruction operands, dispatch arrays and report-population flow. Addresses are native virtual addresses, not captured text or screenshot OCR.

# This is a translation source inventory, not an execution/test report. Dynamic identity/date/site/item text is described by typed fields; world-generated combinations cannot be enumerated as a finite literal list.
# literal-reference rows preserve native C strings (including repeated suffix operands); assembled-template/alternatives rows reconstruct append flow; switch-case rows preserve all dispatch values.
# Upstream report creation admits revealed event types 75 (agreement_formed), 128 (hfs_formed_intrigue_relationship), and 129 (hfs_failed_intrigue_relationship).

# Child source catalogues: data/extracted/justice-agreement-sources.tsv (agreement, negotiation and ritual motivation); data/extracted/justice-intrigue-sources.tsv (successful/failed recruitment and intrigue methods, reactions and results).
# Existing grammar covers the two direct report formatters; child history descriptions are independent sources and must not be limited to a screenshot.
